_what: The clock time (New York) at which each publisher's release is out, for the data page's Next published column (s2/next_published.py). 'published': the publisher states the hour. 'measured': the publisher states no hour, so the time is the LATEST of the observed posting times of its last releases, rounded up to the next five-minute mark after that minute, so the page never points before the data are out. Built 15 November 2026 (collection 1052; Anthony 12:34 PT: every Next published row carries the exact time). Times are Eastern (EST/EDT as on the day).
rule_measured: latest observed minute, then the next five-minute mark strictly after it (12:03 -> 12:05; 11:45 -> 11:50)
